# tests/fixtures/v4/machine/ — index

Epic V4B1 fixtures for the 4.0.0 machine superset
(`delivery/v4/epics/epics-b-core.md` Epic V4B1). Each negative fixture is the
live 4.0.0 `machine.json` (see `plugins/plan-it/skills/plan-it/machine.json`)
with exactly one mutation applied, so `gate-check machine-diff` against
`tests/fixtures/v3/machine.v3.7fcff27.json` fails closed with the exact named
reason — proving `checkMachineAdditive` actually discriminates, not just
passes unconditionally.

| fixture | case | mutation | expected `machine-diff` reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| `neg-initial-changed.json` | T-V4B1-07 | `initial: "triage"` | `initial changed: "intake" → "triage"` |
| `neg-state-dropped.json` | T-V4B1-08 | `adversaryGate` state removed | `baseline state missing/renamed in live machine: "adversaryGate"` |
| `neg-event-dropped.json` | T-V4B1-09 | `dodLock.on.DOD_LOCKED` removed | `baseline transition dropped: dodLock.on.DOD_LOCKED` |
| `neg-guard-swapped.json` | T-V4B1-10 | `scopeGate.on.G1_APPROVED.guard` → `artifactsOnDisk` | `guard mapping changed on scopeGate.on.G1_APPROVED: "gateRecorded" → "artifactsOnDisk"` |
| `neg-retarget-baseline.json` | T-V4B1-11 | `freezeGate.on.G3_APPROVED.target` → `parallelPlanning` (a pre-existing baseline state) | `… onto a pre-existing baseline state — only insertion of NEW states is additive` |
| `neg-guard-removed.json` | T-V4B1-12 | `meta.guards.adversarialDepth` removed | `baseline guard missing/renamed in live machine: "adversarialDepth"` |
| `guided-run/.plan-it/g1.state.json` | T-V4B1-06 | (positive fixture) — a guided run at `freezeGate` with G0/G1/G2 recorded owner+date, exactly as a 3.0.1 run would | `gate-check state` exits 0, `state: freezeGate`, `next events: G3_APPROVED` only |

Regenerated by the (unchecked-in) generator that produced them: read the live
`machine.json`, apply the one listed mutation, write. Never hand-edited after
generation, so each fixture is byte-provably "the 4.0.0 file plus exactly one
change".

Consumed by `tests/v4/core/machine-negatives.mjs` (T-V4B1-07…12) and
`tests/v4/core/guided-unchanged.mjs` (T-V4B1-05, 06).
